name: Universal IDP Pipeline
description: Complete intelligent document pipeline: detects scanned vs digital, routes through OCR, selects pages, chunks by token count, extracts with LLM, routes by confidence, applies rules, and sends to auto-approved or pending-review output.

node.description: Manual upload of single or multiple documents (PDF, image, Excel, Word).

files.info: Upload one or more documents to process.
files.name: files

allow_multiple.info: When enabled, multiple files can be uploaded at once.
allow_multiple.name: allow_multiple

node.description: Detects whether a document has a native text layer (digital) or is image-only (scanned). Feeds a Condition node.

min_text_length.info: Minimum character count to classify a page as digital.
min_text_length.name: min_text_length

node.description: If/else branch: routes the document down the true or false path based on a configurable condition.

document.info: Document or data to evaluate the condition against.
document.name: document

field.info: Name of the field or flag to test (e.g. document_type, confidence). Leave blank to test the full input.
field.name: field

operator.info: Comparison operator applied between the field value and the threshold value.
operator.name: operator

value.info: Value to compare against. For numeric operators enter a number (e.g. 0.8).
value.name: value

node.description: Detects and corrects skewed scanned pages before OCR.

threshold.info: Minimum skew angle (degrees) to trigger correction.
threshold.name: threshold

node.description: Detects and corrects 90 / 180 / 270 degree page rotation.

allowed_angles.info: Comma-separated rotation angles to detect and correct.
allowed_angles.name: allowed_angles

node.description: OCR engine optimised for scanned documents; produces structured text blocks.

document.info: Pre-processed document image to run OCR on.
document.name: document

language.info: Primary language of the document text.
language.name: language

confidence_threshold.info: Minimum OCR confidence score to include a text block.
confidence_threshold.name: confidence_threshold

node.description: Joins two branches (e.g. after a Condition split) back into a single flow.

branch_a.info: First branch input (e.g. true / scanned path).
branch_a.name: branch_a

branch_b.info: Second branch input (e.g. false / digital path).
branch_b.name: branch_b

node.description: Slices a document to a specific page range before OCR or extraction.

selection_mode.info: How to select pages: first N pages, last N pages, a custom range, or all pages.
selection_mode.name: selection_mode

first_n_pages.info: Used when Selection Mode is 'first_n' or 'last_n'. Number of pages to keep.
first_n_pages.name: first_n_pages

page_range_start.info: Used when Selection Mode is 'range'. First page number (1-based, inclusive).
page_range_start.name: page_range_start

page_range_end.info: Used when Selection Mode is 'range'. Last page number (1-based, inclusive).
page_range_end.name: page_range_end

node.description: Splits a long document into token-bounded chunks before sending to an LLM, respecting the model's context window.

document.info: Document text to split into chunks.
document.name: document

chunk_size_tokens.info: Maximum number of tokens per chunk. Keep below the target LLM's context limit.
chunk_size_tokens.name: chunk_size_tokens

overlap_tokens.info: Number of tokens repeated between adjacent chunks to preserve context across boundaries.
overlap_tokens.name: overlap_tokens

chunking_method.info: fixed_token: hard split at token count; semantic: split at sentence/paragraph; section_based: split on headings.
chunking_method.name: chunking_method

model_name.info: Model whose tokenizer is used to count tokens accurately.
model_name.name: model_name

node.description: User writes a freeform prompt describing the fields to extract from the document.

document.info: Text blocks from OCR or raw document.
document.name: document

prompt.info: Describe the fields to extract. Example: 'Extract invoice number, date, vendor name, and total amount.'
prompt.name: prompt
prompt.value: Extract all key fields from this document: document number, date, parties involved, amounts, and any important terms or conditions. Return as structured JSON.

node.description: Combines per-chunk extraction results from Chunking Strategy into one unified document result.

chunks_data.info: Extracted data from each chunk, collected from the downstream extraction node.
chunks_data.name: chunks_data

dedup_strategy.info: How to handle the same field appearing in multiple chunks.
dedup_strategy.name: dedup_strategy

node.description: Routes extracted data based on overall confidence score — high confidence to approval, low to review.

data.info: Extracted data containing a confidence score field.
data.name: data

confidence_field.info: Name of the field that holds the overall confidence score (0–1).
confidence_field.name: confidence_field

threshold.info: Scores at or above this value go to High Confidence; below go to Low Confidence.
threshold.name: threshold

node.description: Customisable rule builder with multiple condition rows and AND / OR logic.

data.info: Extracted data to evaluate rules against.
data.name: data

logic_operator.info: Combine all condition rows with AND or OR logic.
logic_operator.name: logic_operator

node.description: Reads the rule outcome and routes to auto-approved or pending-review output for the Processed Docs page.

data.info: Output from Rules / Conditions or Confidence Router.
data.name: data

approval_field.info: Field name in the data that contains the approval decision.
approval_field.name: approval_field

approve_value.info: Field value that triggers the auto-approved path; anything else goes to pending review.
approve_value.name: approve_value

node.description: Terminal node that sends extracted results to the global Processed Docs page.

data.info: Final extracted (and optionally validated) data to store.
data.name: data

label.info: Optional label shown in the Processed Docs page.
label.name: label

node.description: Terminal node that sends extracted results to the global Processed Docs page.

data.info: Final extracted (and optionally validated) data to store.
data.name: data

label.info: Optional label shown in the Processed Docs page.
label.name: label

data.info: Final extracted (and optionally validated) data to store.
data.name: data

label.info: Optional label shown in the Processed Docs page.
label.name: label
